```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(ROCR)
library(caret)
```

Loading file
```{r}
gene_exp <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/gene_exp.RData")
pt_status <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_status.RData")
pt_char <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_char.RData")
```
Splitting by cohort and outcome

```{r}
source("../rf_functions.R")
```


#Creating objects for runs
```{r}
full_list <- colnames(gene_exp)[2:length(gene_exp)]
clin_list <- colnames(pt_char)[2:length(pt_char)]
bor_list <- c("CCR6")
logr_list <- c("VTCN1", "CD276", "CD8A")
greedy_list <- c("CCR6", "KIR_Activating_Subgroup_1", "CD276", "EGR1", "ZBTB7B", "CD8A", "GUSB", "CD160", "YWHAZ", "IL-2", "CEACAM1", "HPRT1", "UBC") 

#Unshuffled 
seed_list <- c(12345:12369)
#Shuffled
run_number <- 1:1000
seed_list_r <- c(12345:13344)

nullmodel <- full_join(gene_exp, pt_char)
null_list <- colnames(nullmodel)[2:length(nullmodel)]
```


#Adj rec null model
```{r}
rf_rec_nullmodel_random <- shuffled_rf(seed_list,
                                        "Therapy complete",
                                        "Progression",
                                        pt_status,
                                        nullmodel,
                                        "Adj_Exp",
                                        "Adj_Val",
                                        null_list
)



saveRDS(rf_rec_nullmodel_random, file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_nullmodel_random.RData")

```



#Adj rec greedy list
```{r}

 #running predictive model
 rf_rec_greedylist <- kTest(seed_list,
                     "Therapy complete",
                     "Progression",
                     "Model",
                     pt_status,
                     gene_exp,
                     "Adj_Exp",
                     "Adj_Val",
                     greedy_list)


saveRDS(rf_rec_greedylist, file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_greedylist.RData")





rec.greedylist <- met.p.calc(rf_rec_nullmodel_random,
                        "Progression",
                       rf_rec_greedylist)


metric_graph(rf_rec_nullmodel_random,
             "Progression",
             rf_rec_greedylist)

```

#Loading files for graph
```{r}
rf_rec_nullmodel_random <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_nullmodel_random.RData")
rf_rec_clinical <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_clinical.RData")
rf_rec_fullpanel <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_fullpanel.RData")
rf_rec_boruta <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_boruta.RData")
rf_rec_greedylist <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_greedylist.RData")
rf_rec_logr <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_logr.RData")

```


#F1 graph
```{r}
f1.graph(rf_rec_nullmodel_random,
         rf_rec_clinical,
         rf_rec_fullpanel,
         rf_rec_boruta,
         rf_rec_greedylist, 
         rf_rec_logr, 
         "Progression")

ggsave("../figures/rf_rec_f1graph.png", width = 12, height = 5)

```



#MCC graph
